info.title: HackAI API
info.description: Time-tracking and coaching API for HackAI. Auth is via the HttpOnly `__Host-hackai_session` cookie (set after Hack Club OIDC login at `/auth/callback`) or a Bearer installation token for CLI sync/ingest endpoints.

SessionCookie.name: __Host-hackai_session
SessionCookie.description: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax session cookie set by `/auth/callback` after Hack Club OIDC login. Authenticated endpoints also accept a Bearer installation token where noted.

BearerToken.description: CLI installation token (api_key) issued via CLI pairing or `/api/v1/me/api-key`.

habit_breakdown.description: Null until episode labels are synced; unavailable metrics are never fabricated.
